get.description: Every authenticated caller has a planner account: this endpoint creates the profile on first access if they do not exist yet. displayName is the user-confirmed name or null; suggestedDisplayName is a private, editable suggestion that is never public identity. delete.summary: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's planner account and all related data.

post.summary: Selectively imports integration data, progress, and goals from V1.
post.description: V1 credentials are used once and never persisted. After profile retrieval, each selected part is applied independently and reports Imported, Skipped, or Failed. Goals are created directly by this operation, in V1 priority order — the response carries one outcome per source V1 goal (created, skipped, or failed), one per linked unit when a pre-farm goal fans out, plus one per automatically added prerequisite. The goals part is refused (no goals created) when the account has no player data snapshot. The legendaryEventPlans part creates one Legendary Event plan per V1 event (never touching a plan that already has teams) and reports one outcome per V1 event in legendaryEventOutcomes.

post.summary: Creates one goal, or several linked goals for one entity, in one call.
post.description: A single goal is a one-spec request. Each spec's DependsOnIndex (indices into this same request's Goals list, referencing only earlier entries) is resolved into real DependsOn edges; DependsOnGoalIds adds edges to the same unit's existing Active/Paused goals, and an existing Ascension goal reachable through them lifts the rarity cap the targets are validated against. A goal type may appear more than once when the end targets differ. Assigns the whole set to the given project(s), or the caller's default project (created on first use) when none is given. Each spec may carry notes. position (request-level, 1 to in-flight count + 1) inserts the set there in request order, shifting later goals down; null appends at the end. Every goal starts Active; startPaused (request-level boolean, default false) creates the whole set Paused instead and cannot be set per goal.

200.description: The newly created goals, in request order.

400.description: Invalid entity/goal type, a bad DependsOnIndex or DependsOnGoalIds, an unknown project, a null/per-goal startPaused, notes over the limit, or a position out of range.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

404.description: The authenticated account/profile has not been provisioned.

409.description: slotOccupied: an active or paused goal already holds one of the requested slots (current: that goal).

get.description: Excludes archived goals by default; pass ?archived=true to list only archived goals. Each entry is the full goal detail (config, snapshot, projectIds, revision, globalPriority), identical to GET goals/{goalId}.

200.description: The caller's goals.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

put.summary: Reorders every in-flight goal in the account-wide order.
put.description: GoalIds must be the exact, duplicate-free set of the caller's Active and Paused goals, ExpectedRevision the revision last read. Any ordering is accepted, including one that places a goal ahead of a DependsOn prerequisite it hasn't reached.

200.description: The new revision and canonical order.

400.description: Bad Request

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

404.description: The authenticated account/profile has not been provisioned.

409.description: The goal set or revision is stale, or the request repeats a goal; nothing changed.

post.summary: Transitions one or many goals to a status (Active/Paused/Completed/Archived), atomically.
post.description: expectedOrderRevision is required when a goal enters or leaves the in-flight set (to or from Completed/Archived) and ignored otherwise. Any rejection changes nothing.

200.description: Every named goal's detail, in request order, and the order revision after the transition.

400.description: goalIds empty or repeated, an unknown status, or a missing expectedOrderRevision.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

404.description: A goal id is not one of the caller's goals.

409.description: slotOccupied (goalId names the goal, current the goal holding its slot) or goalOrderStale (current: { revision, goalIds }).

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

404.description: No matching goal owned by the caller.

put.summary: Edits a goal's target, details, project memberships and priority in one atomic request.
put.description: Every section is optional and an absent section leaves that aspect unchanged; a request with no section is a no-op. Sections apply in the order target, details, projectIds, priority; if any fails nothing is saved. target carries its own expectedRevision (the goal revision); priority.position is the 1-based position among the account's Active/Paused goals and priority.expectedOrderRevision the order revision the client computed it from. The response carries the updated goal and the new order (null unless priority was supplied).

200.description: The updated (or unchanged) goal and, when priority was supplied, the new order.

400.description: A section is invalid (the errors name it), e.g. a bad target, unknown project, or a position out of range.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

404.description: No matching goal owned by the caller.

409.description: goalRevisionStale (current: the goal), goalOrderStale (current: { revision, goalIds }) or slotOccupied (current: the goal holding the slot); nothing changed.
